image_description: A low-angle, close-up shot of a large radio telescope dish against a clear blue sky. The image focuses on the upper rim and the complex white lattice support structure (truss work) beneath the dish. A receiver cabin or feed horn assembly is visible mounted on a boom extending over the dish surface. The dish surface appears solid and smooth with a dark grey underside/rim.
